Clinician: How has your week been?
Client: I have been stressed with assignments. It is harder to settle to sleep after studying late.
Clinician: Let us look at your evening routine. Would you be comfortable keeping a brief sleep and study journal until our next session?
Client: Yes, that sounds useful.
Clinician: We will review the journal together at follow-up.
